question: Should this staged signed marketplace feed config slice land after current-head proof, or wait to merge with the signed refresh enforcement work?
rationale: The PR adds a compatibility- and security-boundary config contract whose selected runtime path intentionally throws until the follow-up enforcement PR consumes it; automation cannot choose that stack boundary for maintainers.
